role: One static helper: getOSType reads the os.name system property and returns a Linux/Windows/OSX/Solaris enum, used to pick client resource paths.
scope_reason: OS detection only steers client asset and library paths; the native engine targets the build host directly and never reads the environment.

members.name: getOSType
members.note: a System.getProperty read, exactly the kind of environment access the GPU contract forbids
